title: Ajatashatru (Kunika)
hook: Ajatashatru (Kunika): Pehli Bauddh Sangiti ke samay ke raja

facts.Pehchan: Pehli Bauddh Sangiti ke samay ke raja

exam_points: Pehli Bauddh Sangiti Rajagriha (Saptaparni gufa) mein inke samay hui; adhyaksh Mahakassapa.
Vajji (Lichchhavi) yuddh mein 'Mahashilakantaka' (catapult) aur 'Rathamusala' ka prayog.
Pataligram mein durg ki neev inhi ke samay padi.
